title: Dedue Guards Dimitri
prompt:
Dedue calmly sets a defensive station with a padded shield while Dimitri stands just behind him, composed and attentive. Background students rehearse spacing. The loyalty is visible through positioning, not aggression.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.

Dedue body lock: Dedue must be very tall, broad-shouldered, thick-chested and powerfully built, a calm shield-wall guardian beside Dimitri, not a slim student.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle. Transition in: correction echoes in Dedue defensive discipline. Transition out: cut to Dimitri pressure building. Screen/camera rule: left-to-right tactical geography; action returns to Byleth as anchor. Audio bridge: whistle, training weapons, bowstring, controlled breaths. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Camera: medium push from shield to Dimitri.

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: brutal block impact, injury, battlefield threat. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging. No skinny Dedue, no narrow shoulders, no average schoolboy body, no ordinary slim soldier build.
transition_in: correction echoes in Dedue defensive discipline
